verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago ships its own official MCP server. Through an AI client, it lets a user search docs, create test users and manage their funds, and configure and monitor webhooks using natural language. A Claude Code plugin and a prompt library add AI-assisted integration building. However, the documented MCP scope is developer and sandbox tooling, not natural-language operation of live payments, subscriptions or reports. The MP CLI that covers those operations is command-based, not natural language. missing for 10: natural-language operation of core live payment, subscription and report workflows, any in-product conversational interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP/agent experience.
